messages:
miguel_ae: Quick heads-up — Acero CTO pushed the POC timeline up to next Tue. Need an exec touchpoint to confirm reserved capacity pricing and final answers to the security questionnaire. Can we get slots?

sara_se: I can do a 30m slot Mon 10:30 or Tue 09:00 PT. Prefer Mon so we can prep demo infra.

alex_infra: Mon 10:30 PT works for infra. I can stand up the dedicated pool but need quota bump and GPU region confirmed (us-west2).

tina_security: Sending over the questionnaire answers now, but Acero asked for KMS BYOK details + logs retention policy. I have a short FAQ doc.

claire_csm: Also FYI they want a 2-week POC with one dedicated node and peek throughput 120 reqs/min. Is that covered by the reserved capacity pricing?

miguel_ae: Pricing ask: they want a capped cost commit for the two-week trial. Can we give a short-term reserved quote or do we need a contract amendment? @legal_bot

legal_bot: For short-term commits we can do an addendum. Need expected spend, exact service SKU, and duration. Send numbers and I’ll draft.

charlie_vp_sales: If we can offer a capped pilot price it makes the exec close easier. Sar a/Alex — what minimal SKU covers 120 reqs/min at 200 token avg?

alex_infra: Rough calc: 1 reserved c6x8-style GPU pool (8-GPU) with autoscale floor 1, expected cost ~ $6k/week at list. For a two-week pilot recommend 2-week flat fee = $11k (10% pilot discount).

miguel_ae: That number helps. Addendum request: "2-week reserved pilot — flat fee $11k — region us-west2 — KMS BYOK allowed — SOC2 attestation provided."

tina_security: I attached the FAQ and SOC2 summary here: https://redwood.internal/ssr/acero-soc2-sum (internal). I'll confirm logs retention — default 90d, we can extend to 365d with a config change.

claire_csm: Action items: 1) Miguel send addendum draft to Acero. 2) Legal to prepare addendum once Miguel confirms spend line. 3) Alex request quota bump with infra-team for Mon 09:30 to verify cluster. 4) Tina finalize KMS BYOK steps and share runbook. 5) Charlie to join Mon call if exec asks.

miguel_ae: I'll draft the addendum now and ping legal. Booking Mon 10:30 PT tentative. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
